identity.title: The SCUBA-2 Cosmology Legacy Survey: Multi-wavelength Properties of ALMA-identified Submillimeter Galaxies in UKIDSS UDS

paper_type_evidence.quote: We present a multi-wavelength analysis of 52 sub-millimeter galaxies (SMGs), identified using ALMA 870 $\mu$m continuum imaging in a pilot program to precisely locate bright SCUBA2–selected sub-mm sources

targets.name: 52 ALMA-identified SMGs in 30 SCUBA-2 sources in UKIDSS UDS

question.value: What are the multi-wavelength properties (redshifts, FIR luminosity, dust temperature, optical depth, attenuation) of ALMA-identified bright SMGs in the UDS field?

evidence.quote: Here, we use the available photometric imaging of the UDS field to study the properties of these 52 ALMA–identified SMGs at optical to radio wavelengths
